[URL=https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/request-a-room-button-see-post-for-mockup-images.1498973/]PLEASE SIGN THE PETITION FOR A SCROLLABLE ROOM LIST!

Stellaris' basic rooms are just that: 'basic'. I've always found them a little uninspiring and bland. Every single empire you encounter talks to you from a similar rectangular room, with a slightly different window, looking out onto a slightly different planetary surface with some slightly different form of city on it. I get it, it's functional and efficiently conveys the information you want it to convey to the player..

However, I feel those rooms do not do justice to the wonderful stories Stellaris sometimes creates, the sense of awe you should feel when you encounter a Fallen Empire, the shock at stepping onto an Artist Enclave and seeing a multitude of alien races, and so on..

What does this mod do exactly?
[*]Adds close to 300 more rooms
[*]Makes available to the player some of the 'hidden' Paradox rooms

If you're using Diverse Rooms and are contacted by one of your own custom-made races (with a room from this mod), it's highly likely you'll encounter a bug that we haven't been able to squash yet: first you'll see the 'basic' room for the race's government type and, when you contact them again, you'll see the room you assigned them from Diverse Rooms. 

If this bothers you immensely, I highly recommend using the companion mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1399069277]Diverse Basics to mitigate the effects.

https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif

http://i.imgur.com/kmsMpJE.png
[*]Potentially more Rooms...
[*]Companion mods that are split by biome or theme, limited 'bloat' in Diverse Rooms
[*]Continued updates as Stellaris is updated
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/902204956/133261907139243840/]Post links or suggest what kind of room you'd like to see here..

https://i.imgur.com/DlOTDMv.png
Ironman compatible! (Unless the ironman mode is lying to me). Should have no other mod compatibility issues, unless that mod somehow extensively reworks how Stellaris uses the room backgrounds.

Improved Space Battles - expand your mid / late game with 5 new super-capital class ships, over 50 new technologies and 11 doomsday weapons - including planet destroying, star system destroying and anti-fleet super-weapons.


Initial Compatibility Hotfix for 2.1. Sincere apologies for going MIA!


Improved Space Battles (ISB) attempts to improve both the visuals and gameplay of Stellaris's space battles. This is the standalone balance portion of ISB and contains only the additional ship classes and doomsday weapons, without the gameplay changes. For the best experience, use this mod with  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=692028161]Improved Space Battles  which focuses on graphical tweaks for more epic space battles. This mod is designed for long games in huge (1000+) star galaxies. However you can lower the mod's difficulty for smaller galaxies through Empire policies.

Features

[url=https://gfycat.com/VagueHarshAmericanshorthair]Ragnarok

[*] A massive super-capital class ship grown from the organic matter discovered near our galactic core. While we do not fully understand the ship or its technologies, we are able to exert some manner of control. It is able to deploy both the Spear of Longinus and Spear of Cassius doomsday weapons.
[*]The Ragnarok starts out in an infantile stage. In order to grow its organic core to maturity, it has to consume 40 planets through use of the Spear of Longinus.
[*] You may only own one Ragnarok at any time.
[*] Designed as an anti-fleet doomsday deployment vessel. 
[*] The AI can use the Ragnarok and its doomsday weapon against you.


Erebus

[*] A massive super-carrier that manufactures and launches fully-autonomous combat drones during battle.
[*] The Erebus launches one drone squadron (10 drones) every 25 days during combat. The drone squadrons last for 90 days, after which they will automatically self-destruct.
[*] Designed to destroy enemy fleet support vessels and expose their super-capital ships.


Avatar

[*] A doomsday weapon built into a massive space station. Doom stars are here at last!
[*] Extremely effective against other capital ships. However, it is very vulnerable to attacks by swarms of small vessels.
[*] Can be used to deploy all available doomsday weapons, including the planet destroyer - Spear of Longinus.
[*] Extremely expensive and time consuming to build. Requires completion of a special construction event chain.
[*] Cannot be constructed from spaceport. Instead, build a constructor that will deploy an Avatar Construction frame that will start the construction project
[*] Defend the construction frame from enemy attacks while it is under construction.
[*] Only one Avatar may be owned at any time.


Sun Crusher

[*] Doomsday weapon that comes attached to a ship.
[*] Destroys star systems, nova'ing the star and turning glassing all planets.  Also destroys all ships in the system. 
[*] Extremely slow. You have to get this ship into orbit around a star to activate it. 
[*] Other empires will hate you for building/using this. You can, however, use this against crisis invaders with no backlash.


Leviathan

[*] Extremely fast and maneuverable super capital ship - it is almost as fast as a destroyer.
[*] Only 6 large weapon slots. However, weapons receive a massive damage and attack speed boost. Does not provide any fleetwide auras


Titan

[*] A massive super-capital ship that is able to deploy low - mid level doomsday weapons.
[*] 3 different cores allowing you to choose behaviour and ship characteristics. Either close ranged tank, mid ranged balanced, or long ranged damage dealer.
[*] Once researched, unlocks various new fleet-wide auras.
[*] Also unlocks doomsday weapons.


Doomsday Weapons

[*] Deployed by either Titans or Avatars, these weapons of mass destruction allows you to annihilate enemy planets and populations at a cost. Full details regarding each doomsday weapon can be found in the change notes.

Stellaris is a game with infinite possibilities and an infinite potential.
So why not start by adding more species traits to your game, for a more diverse galaxy ?
This allow you different options and more varied handicaps .. and advantages.
One of the objectives of this mod is to provide a balanced assortment of traits, fitting as much for multiplayer as well as singleplayer.

Last update : 
Updated for 4.4.

Have fun playing with this mod and remember to give us feedback, so we can balance this mod better and faster.

Content :

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/681576508/3288067088115980313/]You can find the full list here.

The traits added in-game by Additional Traits are :
 - Organics
23 Handicaps
35 Avantages

- Presapients
5 traits
 
 - Robotics
10 Handicaps
10 Avantages

The traits marked by a * are using an event which check at game start, when you modify your species and once a year that your main species still possess the trait. These traits apply to the whole empire.
Hateful, Violent, Aggressive, Extremely Aggressive, Competitive, Belligerent and Sociable traits gives opinion modifiers, like Charismatic and Repugnant does.

Performance

The biggest concern I have with this mod is performance. To ensure that it is able to run on a wide variety of systems, I have added several customisation options. translations.description_clean:
Federations brought us the fancy new Origin system! You want more?
- I've got you covered: This mod adds Even More Origins to the number of vanilla ones!

Origin Description & Features
Below is a list of all included Origins, describing their features. Due to the steam workshop character limit I had to drop the flavorful background stories, but you should definitely check them all out in game!

Back to the Future
Start in a maximum sized Trinary System on a size 26 Relic World orbited by two Relic Moons (size 1 and 11). Your species has the Relic World Habitability.

Ecosystem Integration
Start on a Hive World.

Eldest Sibling
Start with up to two primitive civilizations in your home system. At the start of the game you can choose whether to spawn one or two primitive civilizations and if they're of your own species or randomly generated ones.

Endeavour to Enlightenment
Your leaders have a 20% chance to retain their level. Their leader experience gain is increased by 200%, and your effective councilor skill is increased by 2 as well. Agendas progress 20% faster and last 20% longer. Your leaders have a 20% increased upkeep and cost 200% more to hire.

Fratricide
Paradox had dropped this idea from among their planned Origins - so here's me rushing to the rescue: This allows you to start in a system together with a Tomb World. Funnily enough they did add a picture sprite for this already.

Legacy of Nine Suns
Start on a size 30 home world that orbits a Black Hole. Oh, and 9 different stars are part of this system. 
Feast your eyes on this glorious home system! 
I recommend reloading a few times to check out different effects (depending on the angle it generates you can end up with different camera tints - blue is rarest). 
Naturally, living in the presence of so many stars is dangerous: The Superflare event chain will fire for your home world.
If you are also subscribed to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1121692237]Gigastructural Engineering, then your civilization will have thought of building a Birch World around the core of the collided galaxy - and if you don't block it with other megastructures - you will be able to build it here, in your home system after taking the Ascension Perk.

Out of Sight, Out of Mind
Start with a Subterranean Civilization on your home world. This gives powerful bonuses in the form of additional districts or some districts and powerful jobs at the cost of losing quite a bit of science income for a while. If you aren't careful, they might take over the planet. And you don't want that, do you?

The Chosen One
Your ruler is the Chosen One, an immortal, level 10 leader. They will allow you to start researching Psionic Theory right from the beginning. Though you probably shouldn't do that as it would take about 72 months.

Walking On Eggshells
Start with a Voidspawn growing inside your Home Planet. It will hatch and destroy your empire capital.
You will be able to pick how long it takes at the start of the game. Choose from options between certain annihilation at 1 year and the 'very challenging' timeframe of 100 years. 
List of possible options:

[*] 1 year (impossible, if you do not get a habitable planet in a neighbouring system - and the default ones are disabled by this origin / I haven't been able to clear this myself, yet)
[*] 1.5 years (slightly less punishing, allows you to colonize a planet a little farther away)
[*] 2 years (you don't have to get really lucky to be able to find and colonize a planet with this - build an extra science ship, explore until you find the first planet and go for that one immediately)
[*] 3 years
[*] 4 years
[*] 5 years (recommended, you have some time to explore, but will probably still lose all of your starting population)
[*] 7 years (recommended, slightly less punishing - you might even save a few pops)
[*] 10 years (recommended, if you don't think losing most of your pops is cool)
[*] 15 years
[*] 25 years
[*] 100 years (for everybody who would just like to fight a voidspawn without a particularly challenging start)

The screenshots are from the 1.5 and 2 years options.

Future Development & Compatibility Notes
I am still adding more Origins to the mod (albeit slowly), as well as working on supporting compatibility with other mods, so please feel free to keep any ideas coming my way! 
A specific mod you like doesn't work with this one? Report in detail, and I will fix the issue! Thank you for all the support!

Compatibility
Only the latest version of the game is supported, as several Origins use solar_system_initializers and the mod interface has been changed for these with 2.6.3

As of Mod Version 1.5.1 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=819148835]Planetary Diversity is fully compatible!
It is now possible to use the "Eldest Sibling" Origin with a home world from that mod.
Any randomly generated worlds will also spawn using the Planetary Diversity list of normal and rare planet classes.

As of Mod Version 1.6.0 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1121692237]Gigastructural Engineering will allow you to build a Birch World around the supermassive black hole featured by the "Legacy of Nine Suns" origin (a new save game is required).

All of the added features above are optional. There's no need to subscribe to any more mods, if you don't want to do so in the first place.

This mod should also be fully compatible with almost any other mod (even those adding more origins). No vanilla files were touched. There's one small exception: I have overwritten the following event: colony.50 # Allowed Subterranean Civilization to fire on empire capitals

Human Variety adds 32 new male and female clothing options to human pops and leaders. Outfits are assigned to pops based on their individual ethics, meaning the population of two planets controlled by different empires can end up looking very different. Additionally, the mod includes the 2 new female hairstyles and altered asian female appearance from the UNSC Outfit Replace mod. It replaces the base human appearance and will conflict with other mods that do the same or alter the pre-designed species.

Art assets were collected from several excellent mods I have used at one point or another in the past, and I tweaked a few of them to correct clipping errors or smooth rough outlines. I am not the original creator of any of the new art assets, and credit should go to the authors of the mods I used:

Better Human Portraits https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=748196512
United Sci-Fi Races https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=814332008
UNSC Outfit Replace (by llossaa) https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=802396546
Mass Effect - Cerberus https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=690944745
Mass Effect - Systems Alliance https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=688961875
Mass Effect - Asari Species https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=694901727
Human Revolution https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=687822601
Soviet Humans https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=902688992
Free Planets Alliance Portraits https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=910076962
The Void Portrait Pack https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=899685827
Wick's Human Outfits https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=810981304
The Terran Federation (Blakes 7) https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1270933432
CHOAM - Dune Houses Enhanced https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=716340384

If I've forgotten to credit anyone let me know and I'll add them to the list. Also, if you have ideas for new features or tweaks, let me know in the comments.

If you'd like to swap portraits around or add in assets from another mod, the process is relatively simple. First create a submod from the Stellaris launcher ( http://www.stellariswiki.com/Modding ) and then copy this mod into the newly created mod folder. You can find this mod at:
 \SteamApps\workshop\content\281990\1074841707
Once that's done, you can navigate to \gfx\models\portraits\human and replace old assets with the ones you want to use. If you want to replace a vanilla asset or add new ones without replacing anything, you'll need to edit the clothing textfiles at \gfx\portraits\asset_selectors. You can search for the filename of a vanilla asset and replace it, or add new portraits to existing categories. Once all that's done, all you have to do is restart the Stellaris launcher, disable this mod and enable your new submod.

Special thanks:
Anthoux
llossaa

Real Space - Ships in Scaling  v 1.19 

This version is compatible with patch 4.4 Pegasus.

This mod is an evolution of the [url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1302974986]Space Battles mod, adapted for the new version of [url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1887282318]System Scaling. This changes the radius of the battles and the speed of flights in the system, so that it would better correspond to the changed scale of the system.

When I started updating the Space Battles, I discovered a problem that I had not previously paid attention to. With an increase of 6 times, this became very noticeable. The fact is that with a proportional decrease in the range of the guns, the battles turned into a crazy ball of ships and flashes. Then I realized it was all about speed, which remained the same. After I reduced the speed of the ships in the system in proportion to the scaling, everything returned to normal. Space battles began to look wonderful again.

After update 1.1, these mods no longer reduce ship speed constantly. Although, in essence, they are still doing this, but with one important change. Now both modes globally slow down the flight speed of ships by 6 times, their difference is different.

I decided to add the concept of "cruising speed" to the game. This works as a significant increase in sublight speed when ships are not in combat. Thus, we solve the problem of slow and tedious flights and make space battles similar to those that were in the very first version of Stellaris.

I ask you to pay attention to the fact that Ships in Scaling is now one mod, and not two, as it was before. And this mod now has its own settings in the Real Space menu:

Ship Acceleration

By default, cruising speed depends on the ship's thrusters used, but you can change this setting so that acceleration out of combat is constant for ships of all types. This will make the game easier and more regular.

By default it is set to: "Depends on Thruster Type" (as it was in the Hard version). The parameter "Sustained for All Thruster Types" is similar to the Lite version.

Longer Battles

For more spectacular space battles, long battles are enabled by default. This is achieved by reducing the rate of fire and increasing the survivability of all ships. You can disable this mode for a more regular and faster game experience.

While the Real Space menu cannot be opened during the game, so you can use console commands to change the settings: effect sustained_acceleration_mode_on = yes, effect sustained_acceleration_mode_off = yes, effect longer_battles_mode_off = yes, effect longer_battles_mode_on = yes.

If you are used to playing Amazing Space Battles, I recommend that you use [url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1880071041]ASB Ironman version to avoid conflicts. With this, you will get all the slowdown effects from Ships in Scaling and the graphical effects from ASB.

Why you should (should not) use this mod


> You no longer could have just 1 fleet / armada of fleets defending your entire empire, because if they are currently busy in another part of space, they would take literally years to get back.

> Having a shipyard close to the frontlines became a necessity, not just convenience. Also, you'd probably want to have 2, instead of just 1 buffer defensive systems between you and the next guy over, just to buy time.

> Guerilla tactics and fall back defences became a thing.

> Ample PD became crucial, because those bombers could eat entire fleet before it even got close to the space station.

> Enemies could capture the system station, repair it and turn on the FTL inhibitor, all faster than you could escape from the system (happened once to my pet Amoeba - that sucked).

> Early game influence could be used for edicts, since expansion was 6x slower.

> Sublight speed bonuses became the most important stat on both ships and admirals.

Solar Storm is a mod containing several events and gameplay elements related to them. These events are not stories of interest from a plot point of view. Their task is to diversify the gameplay on the galactic map, by adding an element such as space elements. If you still do not want spoilers and you like surprises, then I recommend that you skip the description and not read the details below, this may give you an element of surprise in the game.
Solar Storm includes 2 types of events, each of which represents a different chain of events:

Geographical events

These events arbitrarily make geography changes on the galactic map, which can change the position of your empire in terms of tactics, for better or worse. Hyperspace storms that arise in arbitrary systems (most often in unstable ones) change hyperlane, distorting them, adding new or completely isolating systems. You can never know when everything will return to normal, if at all ... In some situations, this can lead to the emergence of new wormholes and this will become incredible luck for you or a hole in the defense of the empire.
There are currently 3 types of hyperspace storms and the wormhole event. With the development of the mod, new variants of geographical events will appear.

Fleet and ship events

These events will affect your ships in the systems of new stars from the Real Space mod. Now your ships can no longer always safely fly through systems with young, unstable or collapsing stars. From now on, these systems are dangerous, you risk losing even a whole fleet. At the moment there are 3 types of events: Stellar Millstones, Solar Storm and Gamma-ray burst. The traits of the scientist and admiral will affect the chance of a safe passage through dangerous systems. Now it's Roamer and Scout. Also in the future you will be able to study technologies that will allow you to build special starbase modules. These modules will also significantly increase the chance of survival of ships, but only in your systems.
Young stars include: Protostar, T Tauri, Herbig Star and FUor.
Unstable stars include: Nova, Collapsar, Luminous Blue Variable, Wolf-Rayet stars and Microquasar.
The source of the gamma-ray burst is Collapsar and Magnetar

Solar Storm can be turned on at any stage of the game, it is not necessary to start the game again.

translations.description_clean:
评论区会被浏览，但不一定会追踪，有事请加入我们的QQ群：637596124
The comments section will be browsed, but not necessarily tracked. If you have any questions, please join our QQ group: 637596124

MOD内容及介绍
如果您喜欢这个MOD，请务必点赞和收藏，您的支持也是我开发的动力。
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/999179622119870505/EF6D735358EC76E28AAEC484A624FF04EF3220BC/
本MOD添加了大量来自星球大战的星级战列巡洋舰以及星际无畏舰的，你能够熟知的帝国舰船，都能在这里找到。同时，这些舰船的生产商——夸特动力船坞将作为一个帝国存在于星域之内，拥有大量可玩事件和极高的挑战性。同时你也将要面对一场关乎银河的抉择。
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
If you like this MOD, please like and collect it. Your support is also the motivation for my development.
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/999179622119870505/EF6D735358EC76E28AAEC484A624FF04EF3220BC/
This MOD adds a large number of star battle cruisers and star dreadnoughts from Star Wars. You can find all the imperial ships you are familiar with here. At the same time, the manufacturer of these ships, Kuat Power Dockyard, will exist as an empire in the star field, with a large number of playable events and extremely high challenges. At the same time, you will also face a decision about the galaxy.
[url=https://docs.qq.com/doc/DU0FDdmNqanVEak9H]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1845920402466222355/5552FC0ACB0B6261538F6830E2040465C22AB01F/

沉浸式的长篇剧情
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/999179622119881203/A7C11A9F20E40E573AFBE19EF05F85D224FEA4D1/
在这个mod里，整体剧情将分为三大部分，前传（启示录），主线，后传（永恒王座），同时基于星球大战旧正史和部分新野史的设定创作的故事将会给您带来强烈的沉浸感剧情，你将在游戏的过程中，在先驱者遗迹的引导下，逐步揭开夸特的真面目，面对来自未知的威胁，最终揭开这场笼罩银河历史的阴影的真相。
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/999179622119881203/A7C11A9F20E40E573AFBE19EF05F85D224FEA4D1/
In this mod, the overall story will be divided into three parts: prequel (Apocalypse), main storyline, and sequel (Eternal Throne). At the same time, the story based on the old official history of Star Wars and some new unofficial history will bring you a strong sense of immersion. In the process of the game, you will gradually uncover the true face of Kuat under the guidance of the pioneer ruins, face the threat from the unknown, and finally uncover the truth of the shadow that shrouds the history of the galaxy.


各有特色的起源
本mod基于剧情的推进，设计了多个各有特色的起源。
在启示录起源中，您作为抵达星域的夸特帝国，你将了解到夸特帝国的背景以及相关的故事开篇。
在永恒王座起源中，您将揭开先驱者的历史，在永恒舰队的引导下一步步的成为强大的永恒帝国，并揭开永恒舰队的真相，最终完成历代人的夙愿。走向属于你的真正的结局
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Based on the advancement of the plot, this mod has designed multiple origins with their own characteristics.
In the Origin of Apocalypse, as the Kuat Empire that arrived in the star field, you will learn about the background of the Kuat Empire and the beginning of the related story.
In the Origin of the Eternal Throne, you will uncover the history of the pioneers, and step by step become a powerful Eternal Empire under the guidance of the Eternal Fleet, and uncover the truth of the Eternal Fleet, and finally fulfill the long-cherished wish of generations. Towards your true ending


不同的结局
在本mod中的永恒王座起源和主线剧情当中，您的决定将会在关键时期走向不同的结局，是生是死，是善是恶，战争还是和平，一切都在您的选择当中。
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In the Origin of the Eternal Throne and the main storyline in this mod, your decision will lead to different endings at critical times, life or death, good or evil, war or peace, everything is up to your choice.

自动化
本mod提供了大量自动化的内容，自动作战脚本，自动化行星等，在长时间的游戏里，给您带来更好更方便的体验
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This mod provides a lot of automated content, automatic combat scripts, automated planets, etc., which will bring you a better and more convenient experience in long-term games.

夸特动力船坞
几个世纪以来，许多银河系最大、最强大的战舰都是由夸特动力船厂建造的：一个由制造工厂和码头组成的庞大企业综合体，围绕着夸特星形成一个巨大的环世界。
在游戏中，他们将存在于地图的一个角落上，会向玩家颁布一些特殊的任务来提升其评价，一旦评价足够高，你甚至可以向夸特发出订单来生产强大的战舰，反之也会有对应的惩罚。而摧毁他们，你也将要面对那些威胁银河的存在
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
For centuries, many of the largest and most powerful warships in the galaxy were built by Kuat Power Dockyard: a huge corporate complex consisting of manufacturing plants and docks, forming a huge ring world around Kuat Star.
In the game, they will exist in a corner of the map and will issue some special tasks to players to improve their evaluation. Once the evaluation is high enough, you can even issue orders to Kuat to produce powerful warships, and vice versa, there will be corresponding penalties. And destroy them, and you will also face those who threaten the existence of the galaxy.


超级歼星舰
夸特动力船坞,您将从这里获得这些超级战舰，他们将是你面对最终危机的法宝，同时你还可以在游戏剧情的推进过程中逐渐的获取先进的科技，建造强大的星际无畏舰和战列巡洋舰。
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Kuat Power Dockyard, you will get these super battleships from here, they will be your magic weapon to face the final crisis, and you can also gradually acquire advanced technology and build powerful interstellar dreadnoughts and battlecruisers as the game plot advances.
